impact_story.headline: Water in the basement electrical rooms could cut grid power, and weak backup plus weak warning systems could leave people evacuating in the dark.
impact_story.story: Water leaking into the basement transformer and switchboard rooms could cause a short circuit or loss of grid power. If grid fails, the building depends on the generator, but its starter batteries were flagged as weak on 29 September. If the generator does not start, floor panels and normal lighting stop. Emergency lights and 66 exit signs would then rely only on their own batteries, whose condition is not recorded. At the same time, the announcement system that tells shoppers to leave had failed in September and basement heat detection faulted twice in October, so a basement fire could be detected late and announced late.

reviewer_note: 66 exit signs = sum of the confirmed table. A possible sequence, not a prediction.
